data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1084 opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of 2,896.5 (USD millions). During 2022 the Syndicate recorded a net prior-year release of $85.9m, predominantly driven by favourable claims development in Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property lines. The Syndicate remains exposed to several large events: 2021 exposures included Hurricane Ida/US winter storms and South Africa riots, and 2022 exposures include the Russia/Ukraine crisis and Hurricane Ian. The overall prior-year movement is a modest release (~2.97% of opening gross reserves).

The Syndicate has exposure to a number of natural catastrophe events that occurred in 2022. The largest of these is Hurricane Ian.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities technical provisions claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year movement taken from 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which states a $85.9m release; the note does not explicitly label the figure 'gross' in the short sentence but is presented in the movement note context and treated here as gross. A full gross claims triangle is present and has been extracted, but mapping of some row/column positions required interpretation of the printed table; confidence for the triangle is reduced. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
